_comment: The Android native dependencies a `git clone` does NOT bring, and the only thing standing
between a fresh checkout and a buildable Android SDK.
Every path below is gitignored: together they are ~180 MB of prebuilt binaries and vendored
headers that cannot live in git. Before this file existed their absence was undiscoverable —
`android_build_aar.sh` failed pointing at a docs page that never mentioned jniLibs at all.
`scripts/fetch_native_deps.sh` is the consumer: it downloads `bundles[].filename` from
`baseUrl`, verifies the archive sha256, unpacks it under `unpackRoot`, and then verifies every
`artifacts[]` sha256 individually. Both checks matter — the archive hash proves the download,
the per-file hashes prove the unpack, and a half-populated jniLibs is the failure mode that
produces a linker error naming nothing.
`make doctor` reports which of these are missing without downloading anything.
_baseUrl_comment: A PUBLIC Hugging Face dataset repo, and public is load-bearing: this fetch happens before the
first build on a machine that has nothing, so it must work with no token and no CLI. An
anonymous `resolve/main/<file>` request answers 302-to-CDN then 200, which `curl -fL` follows.
Not a Storage Bucket: buckets are the more natural home for a pile of build outputs, but their
documented access paths are the `hf` CLI, the Python API and an S3 endpoint — a dependency the
bootstrap step cannot take. Not a GitHub Release: those were unreachable while the repository
was private, and this had to work before it went public.
Override at call time with URL=<base> for a mirror or a local file:// path.

bundles.name: natives
bundles.note: Everything needed to build and run the Android SDK. Stripped to the same bytes AGP would strip to at packaging, so this costs clone size, never APK size.

bundles.name: debug-symbols
bundles.note: The UNSTRIPPED originals, for symbolicating a native crash. Not needed to build. These cannot be regenerated without a full ORT source build, so this archive is the only copy — see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

artifacts.provenance: ONNX Runtime *training* 1.23.0, source-built (see third_party/onnxruntime/manifest.json for the commit). Version string verified in the binary.
artifacts.role: Linked by libmobiletransformers.so. Keeps the SONAME libonnxruntime.so; the GenAI engine gets libort_gen.so instead so the two ORTs never collide.

artifacts.provenance: Stock ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 Android AAR from Maven Central, with its SONAME raw-patched to libort_gen.so. Version string verified in the binary. Reproduce with spikes/genai_external_swap/setup_ort_separation.sh.
artifacts.role: The ORT that GenAI dlopens. The distinct SONAME is essential — with both named libonnxruntime.so the linker dedups them and GenAI silently gets the training build (observed: SIGABRT).

artifacts.provenance: Extracted from aarLibs/onnxruntime-genai.aar, stripped, and raw-patched so its dlopen target reads libort_gen.so instead of libonnxruntime.so.

artifacts.role: JNI shim for the GenAI Java classes.

artifacts.provenance: ONNX Runtime Java JNI shim, paired with the training build above.
artifacts.role: Only needed by the ORT Java API surface.

artifacts.provenance: tokenizers-cpp built for android arm64-v8a. Upstream commit not recorded at bundling time.
artifacts.role: Static link input for libmobiletransformers.so — the on-device tokenizer.

artifacts.provenance: tokenizers-cpp built for android arm64-v8a. Upstream commit not recorded at bundling time.
artifacts.role: Static link input for libmobiletransformers.so — the C++ wrapper over libtokenizers_c.a.

artifacts.provenance: protobuf-lite built for android arm64-v8a. Upstream version not recorded at bundling time.
artifacts.role: Retained as a link input; the ONNX proto reader that needed it was dropped with weight_serializer.cpp.

artifacts.provenance: onnxruntime-genai Android AAR, the 0.14 line per spikes/genai_external_swap/README.md. The AAR declares no version internally, so this pairing is documented rather than read off the artifact.
artifacts.role: NOT a Gradle dependency. It is the source the two genai .so files are extracted from, and it supplies the x86_64 libraries. The shipping binaries come from jniLibs.

directories.provenance: protobuf sources/headers, vendored. Upstream version not recorded at bundling time.
directories.role: CMake include path. Verified as a set by the bundle sha256 rather than per-file — there are ~1150 files.

directories.provenance: protobuf sources/headers, vendored. Upstream version not recorded at bundling time.

_abis_comment: arm64-v8a only, deliberately. jniLibs/x86_64 never had libonnxruntime.so or the tokenizer
archives — absent here and upstream — so libmobiletransformers.so has never existed for x86_64.
It was dropped from abiFilters rather than advertising an ABI that dies at System.loadLibrary.
Restoring it means building ORT-training and tokenizers-cpp for x86_64 first.
bundledFrom: the sibling ORTTransformer checkout, on the maintainer's Linux workstation
